# Pinned colored slime recovery fixtures

The three JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`, with `kind` equal to `sky`,
`ichor` or `ender`:

`src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes/misc/common/slime/{kind}/slimeball_from_block.json`

Source: https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes/misc/common/slime

`sha256.json` records their exact bytes. Native adaptations only flatten the
recipe IDs and rename the recipe-event predicate from `recipe` to `recipes`.
See `docs/colored-slime-blocks.md` for scope and remaining limits.
